name: YD Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: YD Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of precision electronic components in China. It offers FPCs, connectors and components, LED backlight modules, and thermal management products. The company offers precision structural components, LCD connector; thermal management products liquid cooling plates / heat dissipation modules, and LED backlight module. The company's products are used in AI, communications, consumer electronics, new energy, automotive electronics, industrial, and medical fields. YD Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
